test.question: What is the MAIN challenge that language models help computers overcome in understanding human language?

options.A: Understanding spoken words with perfect pronunciation
options.B: Interpreting and generating contextually accurate and meaningful text
options.C: Translating between two unrelated languages without any errors
options.D: Storing every single word in the dictionary

test.question: Why do traditional neural network models like RNNs struggle with understanding long sentences?

options.A: They can only process images, not text
options.B: Information fades or becomes less clear as sentences get longer, making distant word relationships hard to capture
options.C: They are too expensive to train on any dataset

test.question: How do transformers address the limitations of earlier sequential models for language tasks?

options.A: By translating each word to all languages simultaneously
options.B: By focusing on one word at a time without any contextual reference
options.C: By using attention mechanisms to focus on any word in a sentence regardless of its position and processing input in parallel
options.D: By storing sentences in alphabetical order

test.question: In the attention mechanism of transformers, what do the terms Query (Q), Key (K), and Value (V) represent?

options.A: Standard mathematical constants used in all neural networks
options.B: Random weights assigned to different words at initialization
options.C: Vectors representing the current word, the words being attended to, and the information passed along, respectively
options.D: Database table column names for storing sentences

test.question: Which of the following BEST describes the impact of large language models based on transformers?

options.A: They only work for speech recognition tasks
options.B: They can perform a range of tasks like answering questions, translating, and writing while also raising ethical concerns about bias and societal influence
options.C: They replace all human teachers in classrooms
options.D: They cannot be used on smartphones due to their size
